title: Austin Millz & Chaka Khan Shipped A Vibrant Single Track, "Nobody Khan (Ain't Nobody)"
htmlContent:
Austin Millz and Chaka Khan are a dynamic collaborators. Austin is a producer and Chaka is a legendary, Grammy-nominated vocalist. Austin is based in LA (originally from Harlem) and Chaka is from Chicago. Both are showcasing their soulful R&B sound. The two talented artists bring their unique perspectives and backgrounds to create commercial and profoundly soulful music. 

Whether you're a fan of soul, R&B, or just great music, Austin Millz and Chaka Khan are an act you won't want to miss. Their latest single, "Nobody Khan (Ain't Nobody)," is a celebration of their creative partnership, blending their distinct styles into a sound that is both happy and sexy. 

With Austin's smooth production and Chaka's powerful vocals, the song is a surefire hit guaranteed to get people moving.
